summary: REVISE. The raw correction is otherwise accepted: the only behavioral delta is in the test harness and its focused test, raising the hard ProcessExecutor and sole source-bound image-build timeout from 30 to exactly 45 minutes while rejecting one tick more; command construction, ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList isolation, cancellation, bounded log capture, failure propagation, and cleanup paths are unchanged. The workflow record truthfully reports attempt 2 timing out during the no-cache image build before Story container, network, image, nonce database, or run-directory acquisition; cleanup completed without error and the externally owned PostgreSQL container remained healthy. Observed focused RED, GREEN 1/1, and complete non-live 50/50 evidence are coherent with the raw test/code change. The correction has no migration, EF model, Dockerfile, package, or production-source delta, and git diff --check is clean. Prior iteration-10 findings remain closed in unchanged code. However QR-115-011-001 is an unresolved High source-binding failure: the ignored T072 metadata still identifies the prior candidate and prior production manifest instead of reviewed candidate 298749a9e4d578aebd4d19efb0ebbfb9ceafa1b9/tree f4ed0c8a6ad0707601d098f94cd4798a7ddd1bd5/current canonical manifest a6895b2b251ea1d5b6f8c6692fa1bbd583347eab9228107e56c6b2917bb81b0. T072 is not accepted-safe to retry until that metadata-only correction is independently verified by a fresh combined review. No live resource was activated by this review.
